reviews.title: Looks amazing
reviews.comment: This fan is awesome. It’s slightly thicker than other 360 fans. I had to custom rig a bracket to fit around the fan for my custom set up.  Don’t listen to the negative reviews about the software. It really isn’t that hard to use once you figure it out. I have no idea why these are not the biggest thing to be shown off but I love how my pc really does feel like a one of a kind.
reviews.author: Russell Sutherland

reviews.title: Great Fans, Tips for software
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1fprXcnueL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71-eZYLY95L._SY256.jpg These were super easy to mount on my radiator (Lian Li Hydroshift 2). They work very well and cool very well, are very quiet and look amazing. I was hesitant on getting them because of the reviews complaining about the software but I’m glad I ignored them because I was able to figure everything out. After figuring it out I can give some tips. To change the language on the bottom left it’ll say English just click on that. The three screens on the software sometimes will switch around so naming the left right and middle won’t really work just pay attention to the image, match it to the fan and you’ll know which one you are dealing with. Also when uploading a gif I had a problem where it kept telling me my file was not in English or something like that but to fix it just rename the gif file on file explorer to something simple like gif1 and it’ll solve the problem. Also if your gif changes when it stops playing to one of the default options just click stop on the preset theme page then go onto customized theme and and click play and that should keep the gif you want and vice versa if you want one of the default versions.
reviews.author: Yajaira

reviews.title: Good quality and low noise.
reviews.comment: Excellent quality and easy to install. They also added an english language option for the software. Low noise until you speed up fan to 70 percent. Screens quality is also very good and can have the ability to add your media onto them.
reviews.author: Naomi

reviews.title: Great addition to my PC!
reviews.comment: Everything worked great with my AM5 Asus motherboard. The program upon opening is in Chinese, but two clicks later and everything is in English. From there on, it was easy enough to customize the screens to my liking
